payload.subject: Production Deployment Decision — Auth Service v2.1
payload.content:
[00:00] Kavitha Subramaniam: We're deciding whether to proceed with the auth service v2.1 deployment tonight at 22:00 IST. Monish, walk us through readiness.
[00:45] Monish Selvanathan: All 147 unit tests pass. Load testing showed 99.8% success at 500 RPS. One concern is the Titan Corp migration — about 2.3 million records.
[02:10] Deepak Krishnamurthy: Set the rollback threshold at 5% error rate. I'll be on standby. Reach me at deepak.k@amperatech.ai or +91-80-4567-8901.
[03:30] Kavitha Subramaniam: Decision: proceed at 22:00 IST. Monish owns deployment, Deepak owns rollback, Ananya on DB standby. If error rate exceeds 5% in the first 15 minutes, Monish rolls back immediately. Meeting adjourned.

payload.subject: Titan Corp SLA Escalation
payload.content:
[00:00] Priya Nair: Srihari Rajan from Titan Corp is escalating the outage. Their CTO Ramesh Babu is on the line. Account is worth 1.2M ARR.
[01:00] Srihari Rajan: We've been down since 14:30. This is unacceptable. We need a status update by 15:30 or we invoke SLA penalties.
[02:30] Priya Nair: Understood. We'll credit $5000 toward this month's invoice. Action item: Monish to send the RCA by tomorrow EOD. Follow up with Srihari at +91-22-6789-0123.
[03:15] Ramesh Babu: Acceptable for now. Send confirmation to ramesh.babu@titancorp.com.

payload.subject: Senior Engineer Hiring Debrief
payload.content:
[00:00] Lakshmi Iyer: This is confidential. We're debriefing on the senior backend candidate, Arjun Pillai.
[00:40] Deepak Krishnamurthy: Strong on system design. I'd extend an offer at 32 LPA.
[01:20] Lakshmi Iyer: Agreed. Action item: I'll prepare the offer letter and email arjun.pillai@gmail.com by Friday. Do not discuss the comp outside this room.
[02:00] Kavitha Subramaniam: Approved. Keep it strictly internal.

payload.subject: Postmortem — Auth 503 outage
payload.content:
[00:00] Monish Selvanathan: Root cause was the 14:15 DB migration that locked the connection pool. Auth returned 503 for 45 minutes.
[01:10] Ananya Krishnan: We ran the migration manually instead of via the pipeline. Action item: automate migrations and add a pre-flight pool check.
[02:00] Deepak Krishnamurthy: I'll add alerting on pool saturation by next sprint. Owner: Deepak, due June 22.
[02:40] Monish Selvanathan: Agreed. Let's also document the rollback runbook.

payload.subject: Quick infra sync
payload.content:
[00:00] Ananya Krishnan: For the demo, the temporary API key is sk-live-7f3a9b2c1d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c and the DB is postgres://demo:Demo_2026!@demo-db.internal:5432/demo. We'll rotate right after.
[00:30] Monish Selvanathan: Got it. Please don't paste that in the channel. Action item: rotate both before EOD.
